description: Create up to 1,000 mission-test configs from a ready import, in the background. Takes `id`, `tag` (import- then 6 lowercase letters or digits; added to every test so the set can be found and undone) and `tests` (each the same fields as draftMissionTestConfig; check them with draftMissionTestConfigBatch first). Each test is checked exactly as creating one is; a failure is recorded and the rest are still created. Returns at once with status committing; poll getImport until committed and read `commit.created`, `commit.failed` and `commit.failures`. Only once per import. Use only when the user has asked for the tests to be saved.

tag.description: Added to every test's tags, so the set can be found and undone together.

tests.description:
The tests to create, each the same shape as the `POST /testing/mission-test-configs`
body. Each is checked exactly as create checks it; one that fails is recorded in
`commit.failures` and the rest are still created.

name: commitImport
title: Create Mission Tests from a Sheet Import
